verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into a sensible side-by-side layout: the can sits on the left, the copy on the right and the CTA below. Flaws: 'fizz' is orphaned on its own line, the centred CTA doesn't line up with the right copy column, and the can is small. B wraps the headline the same way, but its CTA is oversized. The CTA outweighs the headline, crowds the body copy and the bottom of the can, and nearly touches the bottom edge, which leaves the lower half cramped.
